# CDs

## Old 97s

### Fight Songs

Overall a delightful record, feels very sincere.
St. ignatius is a great and mellow start. The original repress I Think sounds
different than the remaster cd! Murray background vocals feel new to me. Go back
and check.

#### What We Talk About

Surprise track. Tango through line, virtuosic instrumentals, every musician
telling their own story that all amplifies each other.

#### Crash on the Barrelhead

this is Not the sound I remember it being. Lol never mind, it builds up until my
memory is served.

## Afro Celt Sound System

### Volume 1 Sound Magic

Motivating, driving, diverse. Very fun and energetic listen so far.

## Loreena McKennitt

I think I love every one of her liner notes, throughout her catalog.

### An Ancient Muse

Her entire thing in the liner notes is detailing her journey to making this
record, track by track, and the overarching motivation.

#### Kecharitomene

Surprise track. So luscious and so grand. A little outside the fairy-y norm that
I associate with her.
